items.title: Frontier Passengers Rush Exit Door, Clash With Crew After Nearly An Hour Trapped Without AC
items.summary: Frontier Airlines flight 2052 landed at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta just after 7:30 PM on October 6th but a jet bridge malfunction left the passengers stuck in a powered-down airplane waiting for technical support. While the pilots departed, the travelers spent up to an hour in a dimly lit cabin as the temperature continued to climb before one flier reached their breaking point.
